notes.title: Elemental Showdown - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
The wait is almost over!
I’m thrilled to announce that Elemental Showdown will officially launch on March 10th, 2025!
Check out the release date trailer to see some of the exciting new content, including more arenas, more power-ups, and more dragons: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NXgIP69_V-0
What’s New Since the Demo?
If you played the demo, get ready for a ton of fresh content in the full release:

 Dynamic Arenas: Experience new interactive levels with unique challenges and surprises.
 More Power-Ups: Strategize and outwit your friends with even more ways to turn the tide of battle.
 New Dragons: Unlock and fight with a variety of adorable new dragons.

Wishlist Now
Don’t forget to add Elemental Showdown to your wishlist to get a notification when the game launches. 

Thank you so much for your support throughout this journey—I can’t wait for you to experience the full game and all the exciting new content!
